description: Ray with starting point A marked and B used only as direction label.

authoritativeText.text: 给出一个射线时，应当指出它的始点和射线上除始点以外的任意一点．例如，图17上的射线$AB$也可以叫做射线$AC$，或者$AD$，等等．因此，在射线$AB$的图上一般不特别标出点$B$（图18）．

inventory.description: Original has only one marked dot A at lower-left start. Ascending ray stroke continues to upper-right, and a B label sits below its far portion without any B dot. Preserve exactly one visible point marker; do not invent a marked B endpoint. The unmarked far extent is not a source point. No arrowhead/measurements. Coordinates schematic.
